name: Gasthof Löwen
kurzbeschreibung:
**The Lion Inn in Pfronten**

Welcome to **Gasthof Löwen**, a cozy and traditional guesthouse nestled in the heart of **Pfronten**, right at the foot of the majestic **Allgäu Alps**. Whether you're seeking relaxation or adventure, our family-run inn offers warmth, authentic Tyrolean hospitality, and a perfect retreat after a day of exploring the stunning landscapes of **Tirol**.

Indulge in our hearty **Tyrolean cuisine**, featuring local specialties like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Schweinshaxe**, and freshly baked bread. Savor your meal in our rustic dining room, where the crackling fireplace sets the perfect ambiance.

After dinner, unwind with a glass of local **Allgäu beer** or a glass of **Grüner Veltliner** from **Tirol** on our sunny terrace with panoramic views of the mountains. In winter, enjoy our cozy lounge with a warm drink and the crackling fireplace.

Our comfortable rooms and apartments are designed to make you feel at home, with traditional wooden furnishings and modern amenities. Whether you're here for skiing, hiking, or simply to soak in the beauty of the **Allgäu**, **Gasthof Löwen** is your ideal base.

We look forward to welcoming you in **Pfronten**!
